newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy, corn offers mixed.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy, corn offers mixed.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean and corn offers were mixed on Thursday while wheat values remained unchanged, dealers said.
Dealers cited fairly quiet export activity.
Wheat exporters were waiting to see if Egypt would purchase any more wheat on Friday and how much U.S. wheat Pakistan would buy.

The U.S. Agriculture Department Thursday said it raised by $25 million the amount of GSM-102 credit guarantees available for sales of U.S. farm goods to Pakistan under the Export Credit Guarantee Program.
Pakistan would be seeking on July 28 a total of 500,000 tonnes optional origin wheat for August 11-Sept 10 shipment.
